date_note: Access to PLAID's KARTE on Nov 13; BASE FOOD announced its own impact on Nov 18.
title: BASE FOOD: about 710,000 customer names and emails exposed in PLAID KARTE breach
summary: BASE FOOD said on November 18 that customer data linked to PLAID's KARTE was leaked after the unauthorized access of November 13: about 710,000 names with email addresses, about 15,000 email-only and about 26,000 name and phone number entries. Card data, addresses, shop passwords and purchase history are excluded. No secondary misuse is confirmed.
plain: A Japanese food brand says a marketing platform it uses was hacked, exposing the names and emails of about 710,000 customers.
exec: Third-party marketing tools can expose a whole customer base even when the company's own shop is untouched.
action: Affected customers: watch for phishing by email, SMS or phone and never give passwords or card details; organisations using KARTE should rotate integration keys.

validation.note: Company notice read in full and matches PLAID's notice and a trade report; counts are the company's approximate figures.
